name: Raj Mukherji
stance: Sponsor of a New Jersey bill requiring large frontier developers to file catastrophic-risk disclosures with the Attorney General.

statements.text: Introduced S4446, requiring large frontier developers to file annual catastrophic-risk management and pre-deployment model risk disclosures with the Attorney General, with $100,000 penalties per violation.
